analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: We only share your personal information with third parties if: You, in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 p. 1 lit. a GDPR, have given express consent to this.

analysis.headline: Shares with External Service Providers
analysis.quote: The Apache Software Foundation uses the following external service providers who help to optimize its services.

analysis.headline: Archives Mailing List Indefinitely
analysis.quote: All content sent to mailing lists is archived indefinitely. By using our mailing list service, you agree that any content is archived in that way.

analysis.headline: Your Mailing List Data Public
analysis.quote: However, almost all of our mailing lists are of a public nature. This means, your name and email may be exposed to the public. Also, all information you send to a mailing list will be exposed to the public. Third parties may collect this information and process it separately.

analysis.headline: YouTube Tracks Your Activity
analysis.quote: YouTube and Google will always receive information through the YouTube component that a person has visited our website if the person is logged into YouTube at the time of access to our website; this happens regardless of whether the person clicks on a YouTube video or not.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Geo-Information
analysis.quote: Geo information of the location from which access is made.

analysis.headline: Policy Not Fully Implemented
analysis.quote: This privacy policy is currently being adopted and may not yet be fully implemented at all websites.

analysis.headline: Encrypts Your Connection
analysis.quote: We use the popular SSL (Secure Socket Layer) method during your site visit, in conjunction with the highest level of encryption supported by your browser.
